system.notes: U.S. Army and U.S.M.C. issue: a kevlar jumpsuit covering arms, legs, torso and abdomen with SP 14, EV +0. Armor inserts bring the leg, torso and abdomen protection up to SP 20, EV +1; without the inserts the suit's SP is halved by knives and other edged weapons. The SP 20, EV +0 nylon/composite helmet has an SP 20 faceplate, 20-power binoculars, radio, anti-dazzle and low-light; the Targeting option for the binogoggles is 200eb more. The ensemble is fitted for NBC duty. The suit and helmet cost 1,500eb; the cooling unit (100eb) is a separate item. (Home of the Brave p.87)
